info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Stilbite Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Stilbite Recliner Detail Creation API facilitates the addition of detailed information about the Stilbite Recliner to the product catalog. This API allows businesses to input specifications, features, and other relevant data necessary for showcasing the recliner effectively. Common users of this API include product managers and e-commerce developers who require comprehensive product details for inventory management and online display. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their product offerings and improve customer engagement through detailed product descriptions.

post.summary: Create details for the Stilbite recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Stilbite recliner. Provide the necessary information in the request body to successfully add specifications, features, or options related to the product.

200.description: The request was successful, and the details have been returned.
